testsuite.name: Kafka — produce and consume, as JSON and as Avro

testcase.name: JSON round-trip — no schema registry needed
testcase.system-out: * channel = karate.channel('kafka') * consumer = channel.consumer() * = 'json-topic' * = 1 * consumer.start() * producer = channel.producer() * = 'json-topic' * = 'k1' * = { message: 'hello', n: 42 } * producer.send() * record = consumer.pop() * record.key == 'k1' * record.value == { message: 'hello', n: 42 }

testcase.name: message headers, and reading them back
testcase.system-out: * channel = karate.channel('kafka') * consumer = channel.consumer() * = 'json-topic' * = 1 * consumer.start() * producer = channel.producer() * = 'json-topic' * = 'k2' * = { source: 'karate', tenant: 'acme' } * = { message: 'with headers' } * producer.send() * record = consumer.pop() * record.headers contains { source: 'karate', tenant: 'acme' }

testcase.name: Avro round-trip through the Schema Registry
testcase.system-out: * channel = karate.channel('kafka') * channel.register({ name: 'hello', path: '/hello.avsc' }) * consumer = channel.consumer() * = 'avro-topic' * = 1 * = 'hello' * consumer.start() * producer = channel.producer() * = 'avro-topic' * = 'hello' * = { message: 'hello', status: 'NEW', info: { first: 1, second: true } } * producer.send() * consumer.pop().value == { message: 'hello', status: 'NEW', info: { first: 1, second: true } }

testcase.name: consume several messages, and filter which ones count
testcase.system-out: * channel = karate.channel('kafka') * consumer = channel.consumer() * = 'json-topic' * = 2 * = 10000 * = x => x.key != 'skip-me' * consumer.start() * producer = channel.producer() * = 'json-topic' * = 'skip-me' * = { n: 0 } * producer.send() * = 'first' * = { n: 1 } * producer.send() * = 'second' * = { n: 2 } * producer.send() * records = consumer.collect() * records[0].key == 'first' * records[1].key == 'second'
